name: compound-cli
description: Jev-powered recall over Compound Engineering learnings and packs
author: Kieran Klaassen

scripts.build: bun build src/bin.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.bench:ci: COMPOUND_CASSETTE_MODE=replay COMPOUND_CASSETTE_DIR=bench/fixtures/cassettes/ce-plugin bun run src/bin.ts bench --cases bench/cases/ce-plugin.json --enforce-floor
scripts.bench:record: COMPOUND_CASSETTE_MODE=record COMPOUND_CASSETTE_DIR=bench/fixtures/cassettes/ce-plugin bun run src/bin.ts bench --cases bench/cases/ce-plugin.json
